// A multi-polygon region: the union of mutually disjoint components. The result
// shape of Boolean operations over polygons; possibly disconnected, possibly
// empty. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Boolean_operations_on_polygons)
type PolygonSet2D
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IArea, IBounded2D, IContainsPoint2D, IDeformable2D, IMesh2D
{
    Polygons: Array<PolygonWithHoles2D>;
}
